Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.name: Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk
Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.description:
🔥 You make ice from your right side and fire from your left.

🌱 At the start you raise waist-high ice cover a few meters wide, freeze five meters of floor or send a short flame jet.
📈 With training: safe restraints, ice slides, careful thawing, larger walls, concentrated fire, cold flames circulated through your body.
⚠️ Ice chills and stiffens you; fire overheats you, and alternating restores balance without restoring stamina or healing injuries.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Overheating, as either half shifts your body temperature.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Shoto Todoroki's Half-Cold Half-Hot. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.
🎒 Starts with: Cooling vest

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Ice Sill, Leftward Flare
🛡️ Resists: fire, cold
Half-Cold Half-Hot Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: ice from the right side, fire from the left. Start: waist-high barrier a few meters wide, 5 m floor ice or a short jet; bigger attacks and combined circulation need training.
Limits: ice chills into movement-slowing frost and stiffness; long fire overheats; the other half restores balance, not stamina or injuries. No control of other fires or floating ice. Ice melts, breaks, blocks allies; focused fire burns people and buildings.
Quirk Strain: light: small cover, short jet; moderate: restraints, sliding, thawing, alternating attacks; heavy: big ice surge; severe: pressure blast, long focused fire, circulating cold flames.
Drawback: built in, the canon Overheating.
Canon: Shoto Todoroki's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public combat or road blocking needs a license; freezing or burning outside lawful defense is assault.
Look: ice right, flames left; own hair, eyes, scars.
